title: Creamy Potato Soup
summary: Thick, cozy soup with bacon and cheddar; an easy weeknight comfort bowl.
difficulty_reason: One pot, basic chopping and simmering.

ingredients.line: 2 lb russet potatoes, peeled and cubed

steps: Cook the bacon in a large pot over medium heat until crisp, then move it to a paper towel and pour off all but 1 tablespoon of fat.
Add the butter and onion and cook 5 minutes until soft.
Stir in the garlic for 30 seconds, then sprinkle over the flour and stir for 1 minute.
Slowly whisk in the broth, scraping up any browned bits.
Add the potatoes, salt and pepper and bring to a boil.
Reduce the heat and simmer 15 to 20 minutes, until the potatoes are fork-tender.
Mash some of the potatoes right in the pot for a thicker soup, leaving some chunks.
Stir in the cream and warm through for 3 to 5 minutes without boiling.
Taste and adjust the seasoning, then ladle into bowls and top with bacon, cheddar, scallions and sour cream.
tips: Mash only part of the potatoes so the soup is thick but still has chunks.
Don't boil after adding the cream, which can make it split.
